					Four.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=17876338356"
					Five.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=17876338356"
					Six.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=17876338356"
					One.Face = "Front"
					Two.Face = "Back"
					Three.Face = "Right"
					Four.Face = "Left"
					Five.Face = "Top"
					Six.Face = "Bottom"
				end
				exPro(v)
			end
